assumptions.choice: Do not execute mandatory intraday time-based exit at the end of each daily bar.
assumptions.reason: The execution feed consists of 1d daily bars. Closing positions at the end of every daily bar would force every position to close on the next bar's open, invalidating all multi-day trend, mean-reversion, and regime exit logic.

assumptions.choice: Assume base risk R% = 2% (0.02) of total portfolio value to calculate base position size.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires position size to be scaled relative to 'Base risk R% per trade' without stating a numerical value for R.

assumptions.choice: Trigger regime shift entry when CVI crosses 1.0 and MACD histogram crosses 0 on the exact same bar in the same direction.
assumptions.reason: The specification states 'When CVI crosses 1.0 and the MACD histogram crosses 0 in the same direction'.
